name: job-queue
description: Job Queue Service: job-service, job-execution-service and job-ui

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @job-queue/job-service -w @job-queue/job-execution-service -w @job-queue/job-ui
scripts.dev: docker compose up -d postgres redis && npm run build:packages && node --env-file=.env.example --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/index.js --names job-service,job-execution-service,job-ui --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @job-queue/job-service" "npm run dev -w @job-queue/job-execution-service" "npm run dev -w @job-queue/job-ui"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:packages && npm run test:e2e -w @job-queue/job-ui && npm run test:e2e -w @job-queue/system-e2e
